emotionalArc: Curiosity about who gets left out shifts into recognition of real risk, then settles into clarity that accessibility is simply good, durable business practice.

transition.description: Open on a hand-drawn website wireframe on yellow paper; a quarter of the page tears away or fades, hinting someone can't get in.

narrativeIntent.narrativeRole: Opens the curiosity gap: who is silently excluded by an inaccessible site
narrativeIntent.keyMessage: 1 in 4 Americans has a disability that can block them from using a typical website.

scenes.script: 1 in 4 Americans lives with a disability. Is your website quietly locking them out?

transition.description: Push through the torn wireframe into a single labeled term card reading 'ADA Compliance' inked on notebook paper.

narrativeIntent.narrativeRole: Names the concept and reframes it as risk plus opportunity, not red tape
narrativeIntent.keyMessage: ADA compliance means your site is usable by everyone, and ignoring it carries real legal risk.

scenes.script: That's <brand>ADA compliance</brand> — and demand letters over inaccessible sites are surging, even for well-meaning businesses.

transition.description: The term card unfolds into three quick hand-drawn icons stacking up: clear nav arrow, readable text lines, structured page blocks.

narrativeIntent.narrativeRole: Demonstrates the concrete traits of an accessible site in rapid succession
narrativeIntent.keyMessage: Clear navigation, readable text, and structured pages make a site accessible.

scenes.script: Clear navigation. Readable text. Well-structured pages. That's accessibility in practice.

transition.description: The three icons merge into a single upward arrow over a magnifying glass, signaling SEO and visitor experience both rising.

narrativeIntent.narrativeRole: Lands the 'so what': accessibility benefits every visitor, not just those with disabilities
narrativeIntent.keyMessage: Accessible design also boosts SEO and the experience for every visitor.

scenes.script: Accessible sites aren't just safer — they're better for every single visitor, and for SEO.

transition.description: Slide in a stamped 'FREE AUDIT' notecard from Business Design Innovations, pinned over the now-complete wireframe.

narrativeIntent.narrativeRole: Closes with a low-friction next step before risk becomes urgent
narrativeIntent.keyMessage: A free audit shows exactly where your site stands before a demand letter forces the question.

scenes.script: <cta>Don't wait for a demand letter. Claim your free ADA audit from Business Design Innovations today.</cta>
